vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: compound-eng-file-todos
Version: 2.53.2

The skill bundle provides a structured framework for managing project tasks using Markdown files in a local 'todos/' directory. It includes a standardized template (todo-template.md) and helper shell commands (quick-reference.md) for searching and triaging tasks. All logic and instructions are transparently aligned with the stated purpose of task tracking, with no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent: it's an instruction-only, file-based todo workflow that reads/writes markdown files in a todos/ directory and contains no unexpected external dependencies or credential requests.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (file-based todo tracking) matches the included templates, workflows, and quick-reference commands which all operate on a local todos/ directory and markdown files. Nothing requested (no env vars, no binaries, no installs) is out of scope.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and reference files instruct the user/agent to create, rename, search, and update files in todos/ and to use simple shell commands (cp, mv, ls, grep). They do not direct reading of unrelated system files, access to secrets, or network exfiltration.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — instruction-only. Nothing is downloaded or written to disk by an installer, which minimizes risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths. The content references local files and optional tooling (e.g., gh CLI) only as examples; no secrets are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always: false and disable-model-invocation: true — the skill is user-invocable and will not run autonomously. It does not request persistent system privileges or modify other skills' configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is a local, instruction-only guide for managing markdown todo files under a todos/ folder. Before installing or using it, confirm where the todos/ directory will live and back up any existing files you care about (commands include mv, cp, grep, ls). Note that examples mention shell tools (grep, mv, gh CLI) but the skill does not require credentials or install anything automatically. Because it can rename and write files, make sure the agent or person using it has permission only to the intended project directory.
